description: This PHP file defines a class `ViewDropdowns` which extends `SugarView`. The class handles the display of dropdown editing interfaces in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, including loading necessary modules, managing Smarty templates, and generating JavaScript code for frontend interactions.

classes.name: ViewDropdowns
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering the dropdown editor interface in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array of strings representing the module title parameters, including translated module name and module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display logic for the dropdown editor interface, including loading modules, assigning Smarty variables, and outputting JavaScript.
